lengthUnits: hundredths of a centimetre (Fish:long:<id> reads "cm"); 500 = 5.00 cm

bandWeights.note: Band 4 (longG/proG) is the Gold Crown band: 10% of catches. Weights are constant across all 87 rows except F3506, the book-hidden fish, whose bands collapse to a single value.

rewardTargetPayout: NOT IN CONFIG: "longReward" appears only in Fish.json (positive control: the same sweep finds Reward_BaseLottery_1 in split_reward/reward.json), so what hitting a length target pays is not recoverable from these tables.
